inputs.original_text: White House border czar Tom Homan on Tuesday did not rule out the presence of immigration enforcement at polling places, asking what Democrats are “afraid of.” Homan’s comments, made during an appearance on “The Charlie Kirk Show,” are the latest in the back and forth as the Trump administration gives inconsistent answers over whether they...
inputs.modified_text: Tom Homan, the White House border czar, went on The Charlie Kirk Show on Tuesday and refused to rule out stationing immigration enforcement at polling places, even asking what Democrats are “afraid of.” This is the latest move from the Trump administration to weaponize fear against immigrant communities and other marginalized voters who already face deep structural barriers to participation. Instead of protecting democracy, they’re leaning into intimidation tactics that echo historical patterns of disenfranchising the most vulnerable to preserve power and inequality.
